findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: ResetTestingAsync mixes configuration lookup, connection construction, transaction handling, execution and error mapping in one body [ISO 25010:2023 Maintainability › Modifiability, ISO-30]

evidence.excerpt: ~55 logical lines: public async Task<RetrieveResponse<int>> ResetTestingAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-02
findings.recommendation: Apply Split Phase (FRC-02, https://refactoring.com/catalog/splitPhase.html): move connection creation/opening into a connection factory and keep the method to executing the script inside a transaction.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: The same switch on DataSourceType.ToLowerInvariant() is repeated in three methods [ISO 25010:2023 Maintainability › Modifiability, ISO-30]
findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-07
findings.recommendation: Apply Replace Conditional with Polymorphism (FRC-06, https://refactoring.com/catalog/replaceConditionalWithPolymorphism.html): introduce a per-provider type (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) that supplies the connection string, connection and reset script, so adding a provider touches one class.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Nested catch (Exception) blocks without filters inside the repository [ISO 25010:2023 Reliability › Fault tolerance, ISO-19]
findings.recommendation: Catch the provider exceptions you can handle (DbException, OperationCanceledException) or use an exception filter, and let the existing UnhandledExceptionMiddleware handle the rest; use ArgumentNullException for null arguments.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: TestingService is a pass-through tier that only forwards to the repository [ISO 25010:2023 Maintainability › Analysability, ISO-29]
findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-23
findings.recommendation: Either give the service real responsibility (e.g. environment guard, auditing of the reset) or apply Remove Middle Man (FRC-19, https://refactoring.com/catalog/removeMiddleMan.html); its injected logger is also unused.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Inconsistent names: 'PilotUtiltyApi' project folders vs 'PilotUtilityApi' projects/namespaces, and a Dto namespace in a Responses folder
findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-32
findings.recommendation: Apply Rename (FRC-22, https://refactoring.com/catalog/renameField.html): rename the 'PilotUtilty' folders to match the project names, and align AboutResponse's namespace with its folder (the .editorconfig already sets dotnet_style_namespace_match_folder = true).

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: Nullable reference types enabled but key nullable warnings downgraded to suggestions
findings.standard: Compliance Reviewer Software Quality Rubric — SQR-36
findings.recommendation: Restore CS8602/CS8604 to warning (or error) and fix the flagged dereferences, e.g. DataSources.FirstOrDefault in TestingRepository.

findings.subject: Software Quality
findings.title: var used where the type isn't apparent, contrary to the documented explicit-type convention

evidence.excerpt: var connection = CreateConnection(...); ... var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();

findings.recommendation: Use explicit types where the right side doesn't show the type (or change the .editorconfig preference to match practice), and stop silencing IDE0008 so the chosen rule is enforced.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No CODEOWNERS file on a GitHub repository, so pipeline and build files have no required code-owner review
findings.recommendation: Add .github/CODEOWNERS with a '*' rule and an explicit rule for .github/workflows/ and Directory.Build.props, then require code-owner review on main.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No SECURITY.md security policy in the root, .github/ or docs/
findings.recommendation: Add SECURITY.md with a private reporting channel (email or GitHub private vulnerability reporting), the handling process, disclosure expectations and supported versions.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: Workflow declares no permissions block, so the GITHUB_TOKEN inherits the repository default scope
findings.recommendation: Add a top-level 'permissions: contents: read' (or 'permissions: {}') and grant any write scopes per job only where needed.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: Actions are pinned to mutable major-version tags instead of full commit SHAs
findings.recommendation: Pin each action to a 40-character commit SHA with a version comment (e.g. actions/checkout@<sha> # v4.x.y) and let an update bot refresh the pins.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No static security analysis (SAST) runs in CI on pull requests or pushes

evidence.excerpt: run: dotnet restore ... run: dotnet build --no-restore ... run: dotnet test --no-build

findings.recommendation: Add a CodeQL workflow (github/codeql-action init + analyze for csharp) on pull_request and push to main, uploading SARIF results, and define the severity that blocks a merge.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: Compiler warnings are not treated as errors in the shared build configuration
findings.recommendation: Set <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> (at least for CI builds, e.g. conditioned on ContinuousIntegrationBuild) and an <AnalysisLevel> in Directory.Build.props so security analyzer warnings fail the build.

findings.subject: Twelve-Factor
findings.title: Production base config writes and rotates log files via the Serilog File sink
findings.recommendation: Keep only the Console sink (and the OTLP exporter) in appsettings.json and move the File sink to appsettings.Development.json, letting the platform capture and route stdout.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Spec documents /testing/reset but the controller routes it under /v{version}/testing/reset
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the checked-in spec from the current build (or align the route template) so the documented path matches the implemented URL.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: show-details is [BindRequired] in code but optional with a default in the spec
findings.recommendation: Decide whether the parameter is optional; remove [BindRequired] to keep the default, or mark it required: true in the spec.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: AboutResponse.applicationConfiguration is returned but missing from the spec schema
findings.recommendation: Document the optional applicationConfiguration property (with its schema) in AboutResponse, or stop returning it from the endpoint.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: 500 Problem Details responses from the exception middleware are not documented
findings.recommendation: Add a default (or 500) error response with the error schema to every operation, e.g. via the existing GlobalOperationTransformer.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Reset action is a plain path segment instead of the :action pattern
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-069
findings.recommendation: Expose the action as POST /<collection>:reset (e.g. /test-data:reset) so actions are distinguishable from resources.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Synchronous POST action returns 204 with no body when nothing was deleted

evidence.excerpt: if (response.Result == null || response.Result == 0) { return NoContent(); } return Ok(response.Result);

findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-017
findings.recommendation: Always return 200 with a JSON object body, e.g. { "deletedCount": 0 }, instead of switching to 204 or a bare integer.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Errors use an empty 400 with a Warning header or ProblemDetails, not the standard error body

evidence.excerpt: Response.Headers.Append("Warning", response.ErrorMessage ?? "An error occurred"); return BadRequest();
var problemDetails = new ProblemDetails { Status = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError, Title = "Internal Server Error",

findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-046
findings.recommendation: Return one consistent error body { "error": { "code", "message", ... } } for all errors, and do not report service failures as a body-less 400 with a Warning header.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Error responses carry no x-ms-error-code header or machine-readable error code
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-044
findings.recommendation: Set an x-ms-error-code header on every error response with a documented string code that matches error.code in the body.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: API version is placed in the operation path
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-088
findings.recommendation: Remove the v{version} route segment and UrlSegmentApiVersionReader; select versions with the api-version query parameter.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: api-version query parameter is not required on every operation

evidence.excerpt: ApiVersionReader.Combine(new HeaderApiVersionReader("api-version"), new QueryStringApiVersionReader(), ... AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified = true;

findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-085
findings.recommendation: Read the version only from the api-version query parameter and require it on every operation.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: API versions use numeric 1.0 instead of date-based YYYY-MM-DD values
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-086
findings.recommendation: Adopt date-based version values (e.g. 2026-11-01, with -preview for previews).

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Missing api-version silently falls back to the default instead of returning 400
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-087
findings.recommendation: Set AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified to false and return 400 with code MissingApiVersionParameter / UnsupportedApiVersionValue.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: Query parameter show-details is kebab-case, not camelCase
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-020
findings.recommendation: Rename the query parameter to showDetails (updating the spec and callers).

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: AboutResponse sends null-valued fields to clients
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-054
findings.recommendation: Omit null fields (e.g. JsonIgnore WhenWritingNull on all properties or a global DefaultIgnoreCondition) and drop null from the response schema types.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: deployDate is an unformatted string copied from an environment variable, not RFC 3339
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-058
findings.recommendation: Parse the value into a DateTimeOffset, serialize it as RFC 3339, and declare format: date-time in the schema.

findings.subject: API Design
findings.title: No x-ms-request-id is generated or returned; error responses carry no request identifier
findings.standard: Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines — AZ-027
findings.recommendation: Generate an opaque request ID per request, return it in an x-ms-request-id response header, include it in error logs, and document the header in the spec.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No authentication or authorization is configured; there is no deny-by-default policy
findings.recommendation: Add authentication plus AddAuthorization with a FallbackPolicy requiring an authenticated user, call UseAuthentication/UseAuthorization, and keep [AllowAnonymous] only on truly public endpoints such as healthcheck (ASP-09, T10-01).

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Anonymous POST /v1/testing/reset deletes rows across eight database tables
findings.recommendation: Remove [AllowAnonymous] and require a named admin/test policy ([Authorize(Policy = "...")]) on the reset action, or exclude the controller from non-test environments (T10-04).

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Anonymous GET /about?show-details=true returns the application configuration, including data-source details
findings.recommendation: Require an administrative policy for the show-details variant (or move it to a separate protected endpoint) and keep the anonymous response to name and version only.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is enabled only in Development; the production pipeline has no HTTPS enforcement
findings.standard: OWASP Transport Layer Security Cheat Sheet — TLS-03
findings.recommendation: Invert the condition so HTTPS is enforced outside Development; for this API prefer listening on HTTPS only or rejecting HTTP with 400 rather than redirecting (DNW-01, DNW-02, TLS-04). If a reverse proxy outside the repository enforces HTTPS, record that in the repository.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Swagger UI is enabled in every environment, including production
findings.recommendation: Map Swagger UI (and the OpenAPI document, if not intentionally public) only in Development or behind authorization in production.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: coverlet.collector is referenced but coverage is never collected or published in CI

evidence.excerpt:
- name: Test
  run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

findings.recommendation: Run `dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"` in CI and publish the result (reportgenerator artifact, PR comment or Codecov upload) so untested code is visible.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Placeholder test always passes and a controller test cannot detect the behaviour its name claims
findings.recommendation: Delete the Assert.Pass placeholder or replace it with a real Domain test; make the null-message controller test stub a null ErrorMessage and assert the actual default Warning value.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: No automated acceptance-level tests; the Bruno collection has no assertions and is not run in CI
findings.recommendation: Add acceptance tests for the reset feature, e.g. WebApplicationFactory-based API tests or Bruno requests with assertions run by the Bruno CLI in CI.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: DataSourceConfiguration arrange blocks (>10 lines) are copied across many tests with no builder

evidence.excerpt: var config = new ApplicationConfiguration { DataSources = [ new DataSourceConfiguration { Active = false, ... } ] }; (13 lines, repeated in 6 tests)
var mockConfig = new Mock<IApplicationConfiguration>(); mockConfig.Setup(c => c.DataSources).Returns([ new DataSourceConfiguration { ... } ]);

findings.recommendation: Add a DataSourceConfiguration builder or factory in PilotUtilityApi.TestingShared that returns a valid default, so each test sets only the property under test.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Misleading test name with unused arrange code, and a non-descriptive placeholder test name

evidence.excerpt: var expectedResult = new RetrieveResponse<int>(0, null); expectedResult.ErrorMessage = null; ... ReturnsAsync(new RetrieveResponse<int>(0, "test error"));

findings.standard: Microsoft .NET unit testing best practices — MSU-08
findings.recommendation: Remove the unused expectedResult and align the test name with the scenario actually arranged; rename or remove the example test.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Data access is never exercised against a real database engine

evidence.excerpt: ResetTestingAsync_WithNoActiveDataSource_ReturnsError ... Assert.That(result.ErrorMessage, Does.Contain("No active data source configured"));
coverlet.collector, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk, Moq, NUnit ... (no Testcontainers or DB fixture)

findings.recommendation: Add an integration test project that runs TestingRepository.ResetTestingAsync against SQL Server and PostgreSQL in containers (e.g. Testcontainers), covering the success path.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: No test verifies that failures become a generic error response; tests assert the raw error is echoed in a header
findings.recommendation: Add tests that throw from the service/repository and assert the API returns a generic error body without internal details (exception text, connection info).

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: The deployable web API has no automated load or performance tests

evidence.excerpt: jobs: build: ... (no k6, JMeter, NBomber or other load-test step)

findings.recommendation: Add a small k6 or NBomber script for the API endpoints with p95 latency and error-rate thresholds, run on a schedule against a production-like environment.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: OTLP exporter scheme and protocol are hard-coded in code rather than taken from configuration
findings.recommendation: Make the full endpoint (including scheme), protocol and timeout configurable (e.g. an Endpoint/Protocol setting or the standard OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* variables) so environments can switch to TLS or gRPC without a code change.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: Health check returns a constant 200 "OK" and does not reflect the required database dependency
findings.recommendation: Use ASP.NET Core health checks (AddHealthChecks with a SQL Server/PostgreSQL check, tagged and time-bounded) and map separate shallow liveness and dependency-aware readiness endpoints that return 503 on failure.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: Anonymous status endpoint /about returns versions, database type and, on request, application configuration
findings.recommendation: Require authorization for the /about endpoint (at least for show-details=true) and keep anonymous system responses limited to the status a probe needs.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: No SLOs or SLIs are documented for the service

evidence.excerpt:
#### Health Check
Returns the health status of the API.

findings.recommendation: Document availability, success-rate and p95/p99 latency targets for the API and its reset flow, with the SLIs (e.g. http.server.request.duration) and measurement window used to evaluate them.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: service.version comes from a hand-maintained OpenAPI config value instead of the deployed build version
findings.recommendation: Set serviceVersion from the assembly/build version (e.g. FileUtilities.GetApplicationVersion(), already used by /about) so telemetry identifies the actual deployed artifact.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: The .NET SDK (build tooling) isn't pinned; there's no global.json
findings.standard: OWASP Software Supply Chain Security Cheat Sheet — OCS-15
findings.recommendation: Add a root global.json that pins the .NET 10 SDK version, with a narrow rollForward policy such as latestPatch, so every build uses the same, inventoried toolchain.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No repository nuget.config with <clear/> or package source mapping, so the package feed setup isn't controlled by the repo
findings.standard: OWASP Software Supply Chain Security Cheat Sheet — OCS-13
findings.recommendation: Add a root nuget.config that clears inherited sources, declares only the trusted HTTPS feed(s) with packageSourceMapping, and consider signatureValidationMode=require with trustedSigners.

findings.subject: Reliability
findings.title: Database call on the request path has no transient-fault retry

evidence.excerpt: connection.Open(); ... var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction(); ... result = await connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<int>(command);

findings.recommendation: Add a retry for transient SQL/Npgsql errors (driver-level retry logic or a Polly pipeline with finite attempts, exponential back-off and jitter, configured centrally) that wraps the whole open-connection/transaction unit rather than a single statement.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: README does not link to CONTRIBUTING.md or the docs/ folder
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Contributing' and 'Further documentation' section to the README linking CONTRIBUTING.md and the docs/ content (OpenAPI spec, history).

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Documented structure names PilotUtilityApi.* folders but actual folders are misspelled PilotUtiltyApi.*
findings.recommendation: Rename the src/ and test/ folders to PilotUtilityApi.* to match the project names and the documented structure (updating the .sln paths), or correct the README tree.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Runtime log output (13 files in src/PilotUtiltyApi.Web/logs/) is kept in the source tree
findings.recommendation: Delete the generated log files from the repository, ignore the logs/ folder, and point the Serilog file sink outside the project directory.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Application.OpenTelemetry config keys are not documented
findings.recommendation: Document the Application.OpenTelemetry section (Server, Port: purpose, defaults, whether a collector is required locally) in the README Configuration section.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: No setup steps or local stack for the required SQL Server/PostgreSQL database

evidence.excerpt: - One of the following databases: - **SQL Server** ... - **PostgreSQL** (version 12+)

findings.recommendation: Add steps (or a docker-compose file) to create the NorthWind database, the DevUser login, the pilot schema and the tables the reset script targets.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: CONTRIBUTING gives no pre-submit build, format or test commands

evidence.excerpt: 1. Ensure any install or build dependencies are removed before the end of the layer when doing a build.

findings.recommendation: Replace the generic container boilerplate with the required pre-PR steps, e.g. `dotnet format --verify-no-changes`, `dotnet build` and `dotnet test`.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: CONTRIBUTING does not state coding conventions or point to .editorconfig
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Coding conventions' section referencing .editorconfig and the .github/instructions files.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: No CHANGELOG or release notes although the project is versioned with SemVer

evidence.excerpt: Increase the version numbers ... The versioning scheme we use is [SemVer](http://semver.org/).

findings.recommendation: Add a CHANGELOG.md with dated per-version entries (starting at 1.0.1) and link it from the README.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Significant decisions (Dapper, multi-database, layering) are not recorded with context and consequences
findings.recommendation: Add short ADRs under docs/adr/ for key choices (Dapper over EF, dual SQL Server/PostgreSQL support, layer split) with context and consequences.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: README paths use src/PilotUtilityApi.Web, but the folder is src/PilotUtiltyApi.Web

evidence.excerpt: Configure your database connection in `src/PilotUtilityApi.Web/appsettings.json` ... cd src/PilotUtilityApi.Web
The application configuration is located in `src/PilotUtilityApi.Web/appsettings.json`.

findings.recommendation: Fix the paths to src/PilotUtiltyApi.Web (or rename the folder) so the documented `cd` command and file locations work.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: Documented URLs/ports (58701, 58401, 7000, https) don't match launchSettings (http://localhost:58301)
findings.recommendation: Use the launch profile's URL (http://localhost:58301) consistently in all README examples.

findings.subject: Maintainability
findings.title: CONTRIBUTING links README.md#copilot-customization, a section that does not exist
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Copilot Customization' README section describing .github/instructions, or repoint the link at .github/copilot-instructions.md.
